name: sk-code-block
title: Code Block
description: A code surface with copy-in-place confirmation, an optional gutter, and horizontal scrolling rather than wrapping. Highlighting is four token classes applied in priority order with range claiming, so a keyword inside a string stays a string.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKCodeBlock(snippet, language: "swift")
SKCodeBlock(json, language: "json", showsLineNumbers: true)
